### 1) What is on the screen
The frame shows horizontal bands: black speckled noise on top x,y,w,h 0,0,768,180, two thin white rules across the middle 0,174,768,120 with a gray rail and a black road band, then a brown vertical-striped fence 0,288,768,48, then flat green field filling the bottom half 0,336,768,384 with a single tiny black notch with a yellow pixel in it near center 288,336,48,48. The eye goes first to the tiny bright blue player-like sprite in the top-left corner 6,3,36,42 because it is the only saturated hue, not to the center notch where play should happen. What the player is being asked to do, I cannot see - no objective, enemy, path, HUD, or prompt is visible.

### 2) Does it look like a real NES game
(a) palette count - FAIL - reads as thousands of colors, not 4 background palettes of 3+backdrop / 4 sprite palettes and at most 25 colours on screen; measured 2494 distinct colours vs 25 ceiling.
(b) flat shading - FAIL - no one-colour-per-shape; top black and bottom green are buzzing dither/noise with gradient banding, not flat NES fills.
(c) sprite readability - FAIL - blue top-left sprite and center black/yellow notch share muddy dark pixels with background, no clear 8x8 or 8x16 silhouette with black outline, lost at a glance.
(d) no anti-aliasing / soft edges - FAIL - measured 2485 colour(s) NOT in the 64 entry NES palette, which is anti-aliasing / soft noise everywhere, including the white rules and green dots.
(e) background 16x16 attribute grid - FAIL - speckles and green dot-rows change per-pixel, not on a 16x16 pixel boundary; horizontal rules are ~3-6px tall in this 3x image and drift off the 8x8 tile grid. Measured numbers confirm the visual impression, no contradiction.

### 3) Composition and text
Crowded on top third with high-frequency noise, dead empty on bottom 50% - green field 0,456,768,264 is just repeating dotted rows with no variation. Focal point in top-left 6,3,36,42 is where the player does not need it; the gameplay point should be the center door 288,336,48,48 but it is 1/16th the visual weight and drowned by the white rules. I cannot see any text in this frame - no HUD, score, dialogue, or title. Text regions: none present. Worst one: absence of any legible text at 256x240; at 3x scale 768x720 there is not one glyph on the glyph grid to judge.

### 4) What looks AI generated or off
Blunt: this does not look handmade.
- Detail without structure: top starfield is random 1-2px static, not designed 8x8 star tiles.
- Bottom green is prompt-like "grass texture" - endless dotted horizontal lines with no tiles, no clumps, no 16x16 variation.
- Borders not a whole number of tiles: white road lines are 1-2px in NES terms and run 768px with breaks that do not snap to 8px.
- Stray pixels everywhere: white/gray speckle in black, light-green speckle in dark green, none aligned.
- Colours that do not belong: 2485 off-palette grays/greens - real NES cannot make that haze, no rotation, no alpha, no gradients allowed.
- Composition reads as prompt: "night highway over fence over field" stacked as bands, no play space design.

### 5) Five concrete fixes
1. Region 0,0,768,168 - star sky noise: delete all speckle, fill solid NES $0F black backdrop, re-add max 30 stars as whole 8x8 NES tiles (24x24 in this file) using only NES $30 white, one pixel per star, on tile centers.
2. Region 0,168,768,96 - white rules + gray rail + road: snap to tile grid, make top rule y=168,h=6 solid NES $30 white, gray rail y=192,h=24 solid NES $00 grey + $0F black rivets every 48px for 16x16 attribute, lower triple lines replace with two solid $30 lines h=6 spaced 24px apart, delete all intermediate AA grays.
3. Region 0,288,768,48 - brown fence: redraw as 16x16 attribute blocks (48x48 here), vertical posts NES $07 brown with $0F black 6px gaps, top highlight line NES $30 white h=6, delete all off-palette browns.
4. Region 0,336,768,384 - green field: flatten to two NES greens only - base NES $19 dark green, highlight NES $2A light green - on 48px attribute grid, delete dotted gradient rows and replace with 3 hand-placed 16x16 grass tuft tiles repeated; replace all 1000+ off-palette greens.
5. Region 6,3,36,42 player + region 288,336,48,48 door: redraw player as proper 8x16 NES sprite (24x48 here) with 3-colour sprite palette NES $0F black outline + $12 blue + $30 white, move 24px right and 24px down to land on 8px grid; enlarge door to 16x24 (48x72) solid $0F black with $28 yellow 6px torch center, add $0F outline to separate from green.

### 6) Scores and machine readable block
nes_authenticity: 1/10
readability: 3/10
charm: 2/10
